+++ b/src/server.js
@@ -0,0 +1,260 @@
+'use strict';
+const http = require('node:http');
+const { normFood, toBase } =require('./amounts');
+const { needs, lack, toAmounts } = require('./recipes');
+const { openDb } = require('./db');
+const { createPantry } = require('./pantry');
+const { createMealie, MealieError } = require('./mealie');
+
+const MAX_BODY = 65536;
+const ITEMS_PREFIX = '/pantry/items/';
+
+class HttpError extends Error {
+  constructor(status, message, extra) {
+    super(message);
+    this.status = status;
+    this.extra = extra;
+  }
+}
+
+function cmp(a, b) {
+  return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
+}
+
+function readJsonBody(req) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const chunks = [];
+    let size = 0;
+    let done = false;
+    const fail = (err) => {
+      if (done) return;
+      done = true;
+      reject(err);
+    };
+    req.on('data', (c) => {
+      if (done) return;
+      size += c.length;
+      if (size > MAX_BODY) {
+        fail(new HttpError(413, 'request body too large'));
+        return;
+      }
+      chunks.push(c);
+    });
+    req.on('error', () => fail(new HttpError(400, 'could not read request body')));
+    req.on('end', () => {
+      if (done) return;
+      done = true;
+      let parsed;
+      try {
+        parsed = JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'));
+      } catch (_) {
+        reject(new HttpError(400, 'body must be valid JSON'));
+        return;
+      }
+      if (parsed === null || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) {
+        reject(new HttpError(400, 'body must be a JSON object'));
+        return;
+      }
+      resolve(parsed);
+    });
+  });
+}
+
+function createApp({ mealieUrl, dbPath, migrationsDir, cacheTtlMs = 0, mealieTimeoutMs, log } = {}) {
+  const logLine = typeof log === 'function' ? log : (line) => process.stderr.write(line + '\n');
+  const db = migrationsDir ? openDb(dbPath, migrationsDir) : openDb(dbPath);
+  const pantry = createPantry(db);
+  const mealieOpts = { baseUrl: mealieUrl, cacheTtlMs };
+  if (mealieTimeoutMs !== undefined) mealieOpts.timeoutMs = mealieTimeoutMs;
+  const mealie = createMealie(mealieOpts);
+
+  function send(res, status, body, headers) {
+    const h = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', ...(headers || {}) };
+    if (status === 204) {
+      res.writeHead(204, h);
+      res.end();
+      return;
+    }
+    const payload = JSON.stringify(body);
+    h['Content-Length'] = Buffer.byteLength(payload);
+    res.writeHead(status, h);
+    res.end(payload);
+  }
+
+  async function postItem(req) {
+    const b = await readJsonBody(req);
+    if (typeof b.food !== 'string' || normFood(b.food) === '') {
+      throw new HttpError(400, 'food must be a non-empty string');
+    }
+    if (typeof b.quantity !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(b.quantity) || !(b.quantity > 0)) {
+      throw new HttpError(400, 'quantity must be a positive number');
+    }
+    if (b.unit !== undefined && b.unit !== null && typeof b.unit !== 'string') {
+      throw new HttpError(400, 'unit must be a string or null');
+    }
+    // Reject values that overflow in base units or in the stored total (x100 is used when rounding for output).
+    const { kind, base } = toBase(b.quantity, b.unit);
+    const key = normFood(b.food) + '\u0000' + kind;
+    const have = pantry.held().get(key);
+    const total = base + (have ? have.base : 0);
+    if (!Number.isFinite(base) || !Number.isFinite(total) || !Number.isFinite(total * 100)) {
+      throw new HttpError(400, 'quantity is too large');
+    }
+    return { status: 201, body: pantry.add(b.food, b.quantity, b.unit) };
+  }
+
+  function deleteItem(rawFood) {
+    let food;
+    try {
+      food = normFood(decodeURIComponent(rawFood));
+    } catch (_) {
+      throw new HttpError(400, 'malformed food in path');
+    }
+    if (food === '') throw new HttpError(400, 'food must be non-empty');
+    if (pantry.remove(food) === 0) throw new HttpError(404, 'food not found in pantry');
+    return { status: 204 };
+  }
+
+  async function cookable(query) {
+    const raw = new URLSearchParams(query).get('maxMissing');
+    let n = 0;
+    if (raw !== null) {
+      if (!/^\d+$/.test(raw) || Number(raw) > 20) throw new HttpError(400, 'maxMissing must be an integer from 0 to 20');
+      n = Number(raw);
+    }
+    const summaries = await mealie.listRecipes();
+    // Fetch details keeping each one paired with the listing item it came from (max 5 in flight).
+    const details = new Array(summaries.length);
+    let next = 0;
+    let failed = false;
+    async function worker() {
+      while (!failed) {
+        const i = next++;
+        if (i >= summaries.length) return;
+        try {
+          details[i] = await mealie.getRecipe(summaries[i].slug);
+        } catch (err) {
+          failed = true;
+          throw err;
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    const workers = [];
+    for (let w = 0; w < Math.min(5, summaries.length); w++) workers.push(worker());
+    await Promise.all(workers);
+    const held = pantry.held();
+    const recipes = [];
+    for (let i = 0; i < summaries.length; i++) {
+      const d = details[i];
+      if (d === null || d === undefined) continue;
+      const l = lack(needs(d), held);
+      if (l.length > n) continue;
+      const sum = summaries[i];
+      const slug = typeof d.slug === 'string' ? d.slug : sum.slug;
+      const name = typeof d.name === 'string' ? d.name : sum.name;
+      recipes.push({ slug, name, missing: toAmounts(l) });
+    }
+    recipes.sort((a, b) => a.missing.length - b.missing.length || cmp(a.slug, b.slug));
+    return { status: 200, body: { recipes } };
+  }
+
+  async function cook(req) {
+    const b = await readJsonBody(req);
+    if (typeof b.slug !== 'string' || b.slug === '') throw new HttpError(400, 'slug must be a non-empty string');
+    const recipe = await mealie.getRecipe(b.slug, { bypassCache: true });
+    if (recipe === null) throw new HttpError(404, 'recipe not found');
+    const r = pantry.cook(b.slug, needs(recipe));
+    if (!r.ok) throw new HttpError(409, 'insufficient pantry', { missing: r.missing });
+    return { status: 200, body: { slug: b.slug, items: r.items } };
+  }
+
+  // Returns {pattern, methods, handler}; null when the path is unknown.
+  function route(path, query) {
+    if (path === '/health') return { pattern: path, methods: { GET: async () => ({ status: 200, body: { ok: true } }) } };
+    if (path === '/pantry/items') return { pattern: path, methods: { POST: postItem } };
+    if (path === '/pantry') {
+      return { pattern: path, methods: { GET: async () => ({ status: 200, body: { items: pantry.list() } }) } };
+    }
+    if (path === '/recipes/cookable') return { pattern: path, methods: { GET: () => cookable(query) } };
+    if (path === '/cook') return { pattern: path, methods: { POST: cook } };
+    if (path.startsWith(ITEMS_PREFIX) && !path.slice(ITEMS_PREFIX.length).includes('/')) {
+      const seg = path.slice(ITEMS_PREFIX.length);
+      return { pattern: '/pantry/items/:food', methods: { DELETE: async () => deleteItem(seg) } };
+    }
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
+    const start = process.hrtime.bigint();
+    const url = req.url || '/';
+    const qi = url.indexOf('?');
+    const path = qi === -1 ? url : url.slice(0, qi);
+    const query = qi === -1 ? '' : url.slice(qi + 1);
+    const r = route(path, query);
+    let logged = path;
+    if (r) logged = r.pattern;
+    else if (path.startsWith(ITEMS_PREFIX)) logged = '/pantry/items/:food';
+    else logged = '/<unknown>';
+
+    res.on('finish', () => {
+      const ms = Number(process.hrtime.bigint() - start) / 1e6;
+      try {
+        logLine(req.method + ' ' + logged + ' ' + res.statusCode + ' ' + Math.round(ms));
+      } catch (_) {
+        /* logging must never break a response */
+      }
+    });
+
+    (async () => {
+      try {
+        if (!r) throw new HttpError(404, 'not found');
+        const handler = r.methods[req.method];
+        if (!handler) {
+          send(res, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' }, { Allow: Object.keys(r.methods).join(', ') });
+          return;
+        }
+        const out = await handler(req);
+        send(res, out.status, out.body);
+      } catch (err) {
+        if (err instanceof HttpError) {
+          const headers = err.status === 413 ? { Connection: 'close' } : undefined;
+          send(res, err.status, { error: err.message, ...(err.extra || {}) }, headers);
+          if (err.status === 413) res.on('finish', () => req.destroy());
+        } else if (err instanceof MealieError) {
+          try {
+            logLine('mealie: ' + err.message);
+          } catch (_) {
+            /* ignore */
+          }
+          send(res, 502, { error: 'mealie unavailable' });
+        } else {
+          try {
+            logLine('internal error: ' + (err && err.name));
+          } catch (_) {
+            /* ignore */
+          }
+          if (!res.headersSent) send(res, 500, { error: 'internal error' });
+          else res.end();
+        }
+      }
+    })();
+  });
+
+  function close() {
+    return new Promise((resolve) => {
+      server.close(() => {
+        try {
+          db.close();
+        } catch (_) {
+          /* already closed */
+        }
+        resolve();
+      });
+      if (typeof server.closeAllConnections === 'function') server.closeAllConnections();
+    });
+  }
+
+  return { server, db, close };
+}
+
+module.exports = { createApp };

+'use strict';

+test('parseUnit: table', () => {
+  assert.deepEqual(a.parseUnit('g'), { kind: 'mass', factor: 1 });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.parseUnit('kg'), { kind: 'mass', factor: 1000 });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.parseUnit('ml'), { kind: 'volume', factor: 1 });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.parseUnit('l'), { kind: 'volume', factor: 1000 });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.parseUnit('tsp'), { kind: 'volume', factor: 5 });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.parseUnit('tbsp'), { kind: 'volume', factor: 15 });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.parseUnit('cup'), { kind: 'volume', factor: 240 });

+
+test('parseUnit: trim and case', () => {
+  assert.deepEqual(a.parseUnit('  KG '), { kind: 'mass', factor: 1000 });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.parseUnit('Tbsp'), { kind: 'volume', factor: 15 });
+});
+
+test('parseUnit: empty, whitespace, null, undefined are a count', () => {
+  for (const v of ['', '   ', null, undefined]) {
+    assert.deepEqual(a.parseUnit(v), { kind: 'count', factor: 1 });
+  }
+});
+
+test('parseUnit: unknown units are other:<trimmed lower>', () => {
+  assert.deepEqual(a.parseUnit(' Pinch '), { kind: 'other:pinch', factor: 1 });
+  // recognition is by abbreviation only, not by name
+  assert.equal(a.parseUnit('gram').kind, 'other:gram');
+});

+test('toBase', () => {
+  assert.deepEqual(a.toBase(2, 'kg'), { kind: 'mass', base: 2000 });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.toBase(3, 'tbsp'), { kind: 'volume', base: 45 });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.toBase(2, null), { kind: 'count', base: 2 });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.toBase(2, 'pinch'), { kind: 'other:pinch', base: 2 });
+});
+
+test('normFood trims and lower-cases, keeps internal whitespace', () => {
+  assert.equal(a.normFood('  Olive  Oil '), 'olive  oil');
+  assert.equal(a.normFood('   '), '');
+  assert.equal(a.normFood('EGG'), 'egg');
+});
+
+test('round2', () => {
+  assert.equal(a.round2(1.005), 1.01);
+  assert.equal(a.round2(2.5), 2.5);
+  assert.equal(a.round2(1.275), 1.28);

+  assert.deepEqual(a.format('flour', 'mass', 1500), { food: 'flour', quantity: 1.5, unit: 'kg' });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.format('flour', 'mass', 1234.567), { food: 'flour', quantity: 1.23, unit: 'kg' });

+test('format volume: 1275 ml is 1.28 l', () => {
+  assert.deepEqual(a.format('milk', 'volume', 1275), { food: 'milk', quantity: 1.28, unit: 'l' });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.format('milk', 'volume', 250), { food: 'milk', quantity: 250, unit: 'ml' });
+});
+
+test('format: unit is decided on the unrounded base', () => {
+  assert.deepEqual(a.format('milk', 'volume', 999.999), { food: 'milk', quantity: 1000, unit: 'ml' });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.format('flour', 'mass', 999.999), { food: 'flour', quantity: 1000, unit: 'g' });

+test('format count and other', () => {
+  assert.deepEqual(a.format('egg', 'count', 2), { food: 'egg', quantity: 2, unit: null });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.format('salt', 'other:pinch', 3), { food: 'salt', quantity: 3, unit: 'pinch' });
+  assert.deepEqual(a.format('egg', 'count', 1.005), { food: 'egg', quantity: 1.01, unit: null });

+
+test('kg and g add up in base', () => {
+  const sum = a.toBase(1, 'kg').base + a.toBase(250, 'g').base;

+'use strict';
+const test = require('node:test');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+const fs = require('node:fs');
+const path = require('node:path');
+const { tmpDir, rmDir } = require('./helpers.js');
+const { openDb } = require('../src/db.js');
+
+const REPO_MIGRATIONS = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'migrations');
+
+function names(db) {
+  return db.prepare('SELECT name FROM schema_migrations ORDER BY name').all().map((r) => r.name);
+}
+
+test('fresh DB applies the repo migrations and records names', () => {
+  const dir = tmpDir();
+  try {
+    const db = openDb(path.join(dir, 'a.db'));
+    const expected = fs.readdirSync(REPO_MIGRATIONS).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.sql')).sort();
+    assert.deepEqual(names(db), expected);
+    assert.ok(expected.includes('001_init.sql'));
+    // pantry table exists with the specified columns
+    const cols = db.prepare('PRAGMA table_info(pantry)').all().map((c) => c.name);
+    assert.deepEqual(cols.sort(), ['food', 'kind', 'quantity']);
+    db.close();
+  } finally {
+    rmDir(dir);
+  }
+});
+
+test('schema_migrations stores names only (name + applied_at, code reads name)', () => {
+  const db = openDb(':memory:');
+  const cols = db.prepare('PRAGMA table_info(schema_migrations)').all().map((c) => c.name);
+  assert.deepEqual(cols.sort(), ['applied_at', 'name']);
+  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM schema_migrations').get();
+  assert.equal(row.name, '001_init.sql');
+  db.close();
+});
+
+test('restart applies no migration again and keeps data', () => {
+  const dir = tmpDir();
+  const file = path.join(dir, 'b.db');
+  try {
+    let db = openDb(file);
+    db.prepare('INSERT INTO pantry(food,kind,quantity) VALUES(?,?,?)').run('egg', 'count', 2);
+    const before = db.prepare('SELECT name, applied_at FROM schema_migrations').all();
+    db.close();
+    db = openDb(file); // would throw "table pantry already exists" if re-run
+    assert.deepEqual(db.prepare('SELECT name, applied_at FROM schema_migrations').all(), before);
+    assert.equal(db.prepare('SELECT quantity FROM pantry').get().quantity, 2);
+    db.close();
+  } finally {
+    rmDir(dir);
+  }
+});
+
+test('an extra migration file in a temp dir applies only itself, once', () => {
+  const dir = tmpDir();
+  const mig = tmpDir('mig-');
+  try {
+    fs.copyFileSync(path.join(REPO_MIGRATIONS, '001_init.sql'), path.join(mig, '001_init.sql'));
+    const file = path.join(dir, 'c.db');
+    let db = openDb(file, mig);
+    assert.deepEqual(names(db), ['001_init.sql']);
+    db.close();
+
+    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(mig, '002_extra.sql'), 'CREATE TABLE extra (id INTEGER);');
+    db = openDb(file, mig);
+    assert.deepEqual(names(db), ['001_init.sql', '002_extra.sql']);
+    assert.ok(db.prepare("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='extra'").get());
+    db.close();
+
+    db = openDb(file, mig); // third open: nothing re-runs (CREATE TABLE extra would throw)
+    assert.deepEqual(names(db), ['001_init.sql', '002_extra.sql']);
+    db.close();
+  } finally {
+    rmDir(dir);
+    rmDir(mig);
+  }
+});
+
+test('migrations run in name order', () => {
+  const mig = tmpDir('mig-');
+  try {
+    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(mig, '002_b.sql'), 'INSERT INTO t VALUES (2);');
+    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(mig, '001_a.sql'), 'CREATE TABLE t (n INTEGER); INSERT INTO t VALUES (1);');
+    const db = openDb(':memory:', mig);
+    assert.deepEqual(db.prepare('SELECT n FROM t ORDER BY rowid').all().map((r) => r.n), [1, 2]);
+    db.close();
+  } finally {
+    rmDir(mig);
+  }
+});
+
+test('failing migration rolls back and is not recorded', () => {
+  const dir = tmpDir();
+  const mig = tmpDir('mig-');
+  try {
+    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(mig, '001_bad.sql'), 'CREATE TABLE ok (n INTEGER); THIS IS NOT SQL;');
+    assert.throws(() => openDb(path.join(dir, 'd.db'), mig));
+    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(mig, '001_bad.sql'), 'CREATE TABLE ok (n INTEGER);');
+    const db = openDb(path.join(dir, 'd.db'), mig); // table was rolled back, so this works
+    assert.deepEqual(names(db), ['001_bad.sql']);
+    db.close();
+  } finally {
+    rmDir(dir);
+    rmDir(mig);
+  }
+});
+
+test('bad migration file names throw', () => {
+  for (const bad of ['1_init.sql', '0001_init.sql', 'init.sql', '001_.sql', '001init.sql', '001-init.sql']) {
+    const mig = tmpDir('mig-');
+    try {
+      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(mig, bad), 'SELECT 1;');
+      assert.throws(() => openDb(':memory:', mig), undefined, `name ${bad} must be rejected`);
+    } finally {
+      rmDir(mig);
+    }
+  }
+});
+
+test('WAL and busy_timeout are set on a file DB', () => {
+  const dir = tmpDir();
+  try {
+    const db = openDb(path.join(dir, 'e.db'));
+    assert.equal(db.pragma('journal_mode', { simple: true }), 'wal');
+    assert.equal(db.pragma('busy_timeout', { simple: true }), 5000);
+    db.close();
+  } finally {
+    rmDir(dir);
+  }
+});
+
+test('unopenable path throws', () => {
+  const dir = tmpDir();
+  try {
+    assert.throws(() => openDb(path.join(dir, 'no-such-dir', 'x.db')));
+  } finally {
+    rmDir(dir);
+  }
+});

+'use strict';
+// Shared test helpers. src/server.js is required lazily (inside startApp) so that
+// unit/db tests that import this file never load the server.
+const fs = require('node:fs');
+const os = require('node:os');
+const path = require('node:path');
+
+function tmpDir(prefix = 'mealie-pantry-test-') {
+  return fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), prefix));
+}
+
+function rmDir(dir) {
+  fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
+}
+
+async function startFakeMealie(data) {
+  return require('../dev/fake-mealie/server.js').start({ data });
+}
+
+// Starts the app on an ephemeral port with a temp DB. Returns {base, app, dir, stop}.
+async function startApp({ mealieUrl, cacheTtlMs, extra = {} } = {}) {
+  const { createApp } = require('../src/server.js');
+  const dir = tmpDir();
+  const lines = [];
+  const app = createApp({
+    mealieUrl,
+    dbPath: path.join(dir, 'pantry.db'),
+    cacheTtlMs,
+    log: (l) => lines.push(l),
+    ...extra,
+  });
+  await new Promise((resolve) => app.server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
+  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${app.server.address().port}`;
+  return {
+    base,
+    app,
+    dir,
+    lines,
+    async stop() {
+      await app.close();
+      rmDir(dir);
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+module.exports = { tmpDir, rmDir, startFakeMealie, startApp };

@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+'use strict';
+// Immutability guard: migrations are append-only. Hash of every file must match the manifest.
+const test = require('node:test');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+const crypto = require('node:crypto');
+const fs = require('node:fs');
+const path = require('node:path');
+const { tmpDir, rmDir } = require('./helpers.js');
+
+const MIGRATIONS = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'migrations');
+const MANIFEST = path.join(__dirname, 'fixtures', 'migrations.sha256.json');
+
+// Returns a list of problems (empty when the directory matches the manifest).
+function check(dir, manifest) {
+  const problems = [];
+  const files = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.sql'));
+  for (const f of files) {
+    if (!Object.hasOwn(manifest, f)) {
+      problems.push(`unlisted: ${f}`);
+      continue;
+    }
+    const hash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f))).digest('hex');
+    if (hash !== manifest[f]) problems.push(`hash mismatch: ${f}`);
+  }
+  for (const name of Object.keys(manifest)) {
+    if (!files.includes(name)) problems.push(`missing: ${name}`);
+  }
+  return problems;
+}
+
+test('repo migrations match the manifest', () => {
+  const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(MANIFEST, 'utf8'));
+  assert.deepEqual(check(MIGRATIONS, manifest), []);
+});
+
+test('manifest entries look like sha256 hex', () => {
+  const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(MANIFEST, 'utf8'));
+  assert.ok(Object.keys(manifest).length >= 1);
+  for (const [name, h] of Object.entries(manifest)) {
+    assert.match(name, /^\d{3}_.+\.sql$/);
+    assert.match(h, /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
+  }
+});
+
+test('guard detects hash mismatch, unlisted file and missing file', () => {
+  const dir = tmpDir('mig-');
+  try {
+    const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(MANIFEST, 'utf8'));
+    fs.copyFileSync(path.join(MIGRATIONS, '001_init.sql'), path.join(dir, '001_init.sql'));
+    assert.deepEqual(check(dir, manifest), []);
+
+    fs.appendFileSync(path.join(dir, '001_init.sql'), '\n-- edited');
+    assert.deepEqual(check(dir, manifest), ['hash mismatch: 001_init.sql']);
+
+    fs.copyFileSync(path.join(MIGRATIONS, '001_init.sql'), path.join(dir, '001_init.sql'));
+    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, '002_new.sql'), 'SELECT 1;');
+    assert.deepEqual(check(dir, manifest), ['unlisted: 002_new.sql']);
+
+    fs.rmSync(path.join(dir, '001_init.sql'));
+    fs.rmSync(path.join(dir, '002_new.sql'));
+    assert.deepEqual(check(dir, manifest), ['missing: 001_init.sql']);
+  } finally {
+    rmDir(dir);
+  }
+});

+'use strict';
+// 100 recipes against dev/fake-mealie: cookable in under 2000 ms (local only).
+const { test } = require('node:test');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+const { startApp, startFakeMealie } = require('./helpers');
+
+test('cookable over 100 recipes (10 pages, 100 detail fetches) answers in under 2 s', async () => {
+  const recipes = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, i) => ({
+    id: 'p' + i,
+    slug: 'perf-' + String(i).padStart(3, '0'),
+    name: 'Perf ' + i,
+    tags: [],
+    totalTime: null,
+    recipeIngredient: [
+      { quantity: 100, unit: { name: 'gram', abbreviation: 'g' }, food: { name: 'flour' }, note: '' },
+      { quantity: i + 1, unit: null, food: { name: 'egg' }, note: '' },
+    ],
+  }));
+  const fake = await startFakeMealie({ recipes, foods: [] });
+  const app = await startApp({ mealieUrl: fake.url });

+    await fetch(app.base + '/pantry/items', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ food: 'flour', quantity: 1, unit: 'kg' }) });
+    await fetch(app.base + '/pantry/items', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ food: 'egg', quantity: 50 }) });
+    const t0 = process.hrtime.bigint();
+    const res = await fetch(app.base + '/recipes/cookable?maxMissing=2');
+    const ms = Number(process.hrtime.bigint() - t0) / 1e6;
+    const body = await res.json();
+    assert.equal(res.status, 200);
+    assert.equal(body.recipes.length, 100);
+    assert.equal(body.recipes.filter((r) => r.missing.length === 0).length, 50);

+'use strict';
+// Process behaviour of src/index.js: startup, SIGTERM/SIGINT, startup failures, log hygiene.
+const { test } = require('node:test');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+const fs = require('node:fs');
+const net = require('node:net');
+const path = require('node:path');
+const { spawn } = require('node:child_process');

mealie-pantry is built, and the `deliver` step succeeded (final handoff at `.eccode/delivery/final-handoff.md`). I haven't checked it on Node 18. Only Node 22.22.0 was available.

All gates (architecture, design, plan, the implementation phase and verification) are approved in the engine record. The implementation phase was approved by both the technical and security reviewers. The reviews also caught the test command failing on Node 22, a rounding mistake, and the Node 18 problem described under the first limitation below. I also fixed two bugs the test-writing agent found: `/recipes/cookable` lost a recipe's slug and name when the Mealie detail lacked a slug, and a huge quantity (1e308 kg) was stored as `null`. Both now have regression tests.

`npm test` gives 181 tests: 180 pass, 0 fail and 1 skipped. The skipped test is the default-port-3000 one, which skips because that port was busy on this machine.

The code is in `src/`, the schema is `migrations/001_init.sql`, and the tests are in `test/`. I did not commit anything; the files are untracked.

**Limitations**
- **Node 18:** I pinned `better-sqlite3` to exactly 11.10.0 because 12 and 13 exclude Node 18. I could not install or run it on Node 18, so that is the main open risk. A `sql.js` fallback is described in the design but not built.
- **`npm start` smoke run:** I could not run `npm start` by hand against the dev fake Mealie. The shell would not keep two processes up. Tests that spawn `src/index.js` and run the service against the fake Mealie cover it.
- **Slugs `.` and `..`:** posting `/cook` with one of these changes the Mealie request path. It is read-only and stays on your configured host, and I accepted it rather than reopen the reviewed code.
- **No authentication or rate limiting:** the spec didn't ask for either, so keep it on a trusted network.
- **Tiny shortfalls:** a shortage under 1e-9 is ignored, and one that rounds to 0 is still listed with quantity 0.
- **Open risks:** six risks are still open in the engine record, and I have not accepted any on your behalf. That needs your answer.
